moments.intended_question: Will she lose the only memory of her mother to the cold sea?
moments.why: Starts with an explosive slap and escalates into an arrogant heiress trying to throw away a precious family heirloom over the water, hooked by a dangerous rescue.

moments.intended_question: Who is the true owner of the mysterious Castell locket?
moments.why: Leans heavily into the hidden identity trope by exposing the rival impostor in a lie and shifting the focus to the real secret owner.

moments.intended_question: What dark secret is the aunt hiding about the Castell family?
moments.why: Bridges the confrontation at the end of episode one with the terrifying warning from the aunt in episode two, hooking viewers on the deep conspiracy.

setups.what: The locket reveals a Castell yacht crest destroyed twenty years ago.
Ines reveals she knows nothing about her mother because her aunt hid it.

payoffs.what: Bianca fails the test and falsely claims the locket is her grandmother's initials.
Marisol panics and tells Ines to throw the locket away to stay alive.
